name: PUBG MOBILE

summary: PUBG Mobile is the official mobile version of PUBG: Battlegrounds, a free battle royale where up to 100 players fight to be the last one standing. The latest PUBG Mobile APK is version 4.6.0, updated September 18, 2026, and needs Android 5.0 or newer. It's free to play, with ads and in-app purchases.
metaDescription: Get the official PUBG Mobile APK 4.6.0 for Android 5.0+. The Midnight Hunters update, game modes, storage tips, install steps and account safety notes.

faq.q: How do I install PUBG Mobile on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for PUBG Mobile and check the developer is Level Infinite before tapping Install. It needs Android 5.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically, so you never need to download an APK by hand. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Level Infinite and may be altered, so the safest way to play PUBG Mobile is the official listing.

Yes. PUBG Mobile is free to download and play. It earns money from in-app purchases of UC, its premium currency, used for the Royale Pass, skins and crates; Google Play lists them from $0.29 to $199.99 per item. Some purchases include random items. Paid items are cosmetic and don't change weapon stats.

faq.q: Is PUBG Mobile available in India?
faq.a: The global PUBG Mobile app isn't the version for India. Players there use Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI), a separate official game from Krafton with its own servers and accounts. Installing the global PUBG Mobile APK in India isn't the supported route.

faq.q: How much storage does PUBG Mobile need?
faq.a: PUBG Mobile downloads extra game data after installing, and optional resource packs for maps and high-quality graphics add more. Google Play doesn't show the size on the web, so check the download prompt in the game. You can delete unused resource packs in the game's settings.

PUBG Mobile is developed by Tencent's Lightspeed Studios under license from Krafton, which owns PUBG, and published globally on Google Play by Level Infinite, Tencent's games publishing brand. It launched on Google Play in March 2018. Updates arrive roughly every two months with a new version number.
